The method / Look legitimate online / Step 3
ACTION 19 OF 32 · PHASE 05

Claim a legitimate Google Business Profile—if eligible

Earn a legitimate local search presence without risking suspension.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter you can truthfully represent an operating location or service-area business.ESTIMATED WORK TIME30–90 min + verification
↗
Your one job

Earn a legitimate local search presence without risking suspension.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Read Google's current rules: businesses need eligible in-person customer contact; online-only brands generally do not qualify.

  2. 02

    Search for an existing listing, then claim it rather than making duplicates.

  3. 03

    Use the real customer-facing name, category, phone, accurate hours, eligible address/service area, website, services and authentic photos.

  4. 04

    Complete the verification process offered by Google and maintain real information. If ineligible, prioritize website SEO and appropriate ads instead.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Based on my actual operations at [ADDRESS OR SERVICE AREA] and how I meet customers [EXPLAIN], assess Google Business Profile eligibility against CURRENT official Google policies. Explain storefront versus service-area versus online-only. If eligible, provide the exact setup information and a compliant description; if not, suggest legitimate SEO alternatives. Do not invent an address or encourage fake reviews.
03

Finish with this

An eligibility decision plus either a truthful verified listing plan or an alternative search strategy.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Eligibility is checked on Google's own policy page
  • Real operations and contact details match listing
  • Photos/reviews are authentic
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Using a virtual address, ineligible online-only company or fake ratings.
